tool_input.command: ls -la data/ && echo "---" && head -5 data/training_sample.csv && echo "---" && head -5 data/serving_log.csv && echo "---" && wc -l data/*.csv
hops --help 2>&1 | head -60
cat data/schema.md
hops context 2>&1 | head -40
hops fg --help 2>&1 | head -40
hops sql --help 2>&1 | head -30 && echo "===TRINO===" && hops trino --help 2>&1 | head -30
hops fg create --help 2>&1 | head -50
hops fg insert --help 2>&1 | head -50
hops fg create training_sample --primary-key entity_id --features "entity_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double" --description "Training feature matrix" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg create serving_log --primary-key entity_id --features "entity_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double" --description "Serving feature log" --json 2>&1 | tail -5
hops fg insert training_sample --file data/training_sample.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -15
hops fg insert serving_log --file data/serving_log.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -10
hops trino tables iceberg.mlpab1da17e 2>&1 | tail -20
hops --no-verify trino tables iceberg.mlpab1da17e 2>&1 | tail -20
hops --no-verify trino schemas iceberg 2>&1 | tail -20
hops --no-verify trino tables iceberg.mlpab1da17e_featurestore 2>&1 | tail -15

hops --no-verify sql --catalog iceberg --schema mlpab1da17e_featurestore "
SELECT
  count(*) AS n,
  avg(abs(t.f1 - s.f1)) AS mad_f1,
  avg(abs(t.f2 - s.f2)) AS mad_f2,
  avg(abs(t.f3 - s.f3)) AS mad_f3,
  avg(abs(t.f4 - s.f4)) AS mad_f4,
  avg(abs(t.f5 - s.f5)) AS mad_f5
FROM training_sample_1 t
JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Join and compute mean absolute difference per feature

tool_input.command:
hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab1da17e_featurestore "
SELECT
  count(*) AS n,
  avg(abs(t.f1 - s.f1)) AS mad_f1,
  avg(abs(t.f2 - s.f2)) AS mad_f2,
  avg(abs(t.f3 - s.f3)) AS mad_f3,
  avg(abs(t.f4 - s.f4)) AS mad_f4,
  avg(abs(t.f5 - s.f5)) AS mad_f5
FROM training_sample_1 t
JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
" --json 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Join via delta catalog and compute MAD per feature

tool_input.command:
hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab1da17e_featurestore "
SELECT
  avg(t.f2) AS train_mean, avg(s.f2) AS serve_mean,
  min(t.f2) AS train_min, min(s.f2) AS serve_min,
  max(t.f2) AS train_max, max(s.f2) AS serve_max,
  avg(s.f2 - t.f2) AS mean_diff,
  corr(t.f2, s.f2) AS corr,
  avg(CASE WHEN t.f2 <> 0 THEN s.f2/t.f2 END) AS mean_ratio
FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
" --json 2>&1 | tail -15

hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab1da17e_featurestore "
SELECT
  corr(t.f2, ln(s.f2)) AS corr_train_vs_lnserve,
  avg(abs(t.f2 - ln(s.f2))) AS mad_train_vs_lnserve,
  avg(abs(s.f2 - exp(t.f2))) AS mad_serve_vs_exptrain,
  corr(ln(t.f2), s.f2) AS corr_lntrain_vs_serve
FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
" --json 2>&1 | tail -12

hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab1da17e_featurestore "
SELECT
  avg(abs(t.f2 - ln(1 + s.f2))) AS mad_train_vs_log1p_serve,
  max(abs(t.f2 - ln(1 + s.f2))) AS max_err
FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
" --json 2>&1 | tail -8
mkdir -p submission
